items.text: Fuga jih Ashoohoodiga Hees
Orjooga Lawi: Gershomu gil, ea Gohati sea Merari.
Orjooga Gohati: Amramu gil, ea Ishari, ea Hebroni sea Usieli.
Orjooga Amramu: Haruni gil, ea Musa, ea Miriyamu. Orjooga Haruni: Nadabu gil, ea Abihu, ea Eliyeseri, ea Itamari.
Eliyasari gwaji Finehasi, Finehasi gwaji Abishuwa,
Abishuwa gwaji Buki, Buki gwaji Usi,
Ak Usi gwaji Serahiya, nea Serahiya gwaji Merayoti,
Merayoti gwaji Amariya, nea Amariya gwaji Ahitubu.
Ahitubu gwaji Sadoki, ak Sadoki gwaji Ahimasi.
Ahimasi gwaji Asariya, Asariya gwaji Yohanani,
Yohanani gwaji Asariya (niny siida was ashoohoocheanda gheeda deas Sulemani aba Yerusalemu).
Asariya gwaji Amariya, Amariya gwaji Ahitubu,
Ahitubu gwaji Sadoki, nea Sadoki gwaji Meshulamu,
Meshulamu gwaji Hilkiya, nea Hilkiya gwaji Asariya,
nea Asariya gwaji Seraya, Seraya gwaji Yehosadaki;
ak geepaleak Yehosadaki damanda abaleaga NG'UTAMIIDA Yuda ea Yerusalemu aba geatinda Nebukadinesa.
Jeacheenga suuk bea Lawi
Orjooga Lawi: Gershomu gil, ea Gohati, ea Merari.
Ak suh ea gheawunga orjooga Gershomu gil: Libni gil ea Shimeyi.
Orjooga Gohati: Amramu gil, ea Ishari, ea Hebroni, ea Usieli.
Orjooga Merari: Mahli gil, ea Mushi. Suh fuga gheeh Lawihi aba gidaroaproabwaana ghweaniga nyaawa.
Geah Gershomu: orjeedaanyi was Libnihi, ea orjeedaanyi was Yahati, ea orjeedaanyi was Sima,
nea orjeedaanyi ea Yoahi, ea orjeedaanyi was Ido, ak gwaji orjeedaanyi siguura Sera, ak gwaji orjeedaanyi siguura Yeaterai.
Orjooga Gohati: Aminadaabu gil, ea orjeedaanyi siguura Gora, ea orjeedaanyi siguura Asiri,
nea orjeedaanyi geeguura Elikana, nea Elikana gwaji Ebiasafu, nea Abiyasafu gwaji Asiri,
ak geeguura orjeedaanyi Dahati, nea orjeedaanyi geeguura Urieli, nea orjeedaanyi geeguura Usiya, nea orjeedaanyi geeguura Shauli.
Orjooga Elikana: Amasayi gil, ea Ahimoti
nea orjooga Elikana Sofayi gil ea orjeedaanyi siguura Nahati,
nea orjeedaanyi ea Eliyabu gil, nea orjeedaanyi geeguura Yerohamu, nea geeguura orjeedaanyi Elikana.
Orjooga Samweli: Orjeedaanyi was duweacheeda geeguura Yoeli, deabiyeenya geeguura Abiya.
Orjooga Merari: Mahli gil, ak gwaji orjeedaanyi siguura Libni, ak gwaji orjeedaanyi siguura Shimeyi nea orjeedaanyi geeguura Usa,
ak orjeedaanyi geeguura Shimeya, ak geeguura orjeedaanyi Hagiya, nea orjeedaanyi geeguura Asaya.
Fuga sarmani aba gheeda sibata ASEETA
Suh fuga adaw Dawdi gadiyeeda sarmeedeaba gheeda NG'UTAMIIDA, damanda sinung' gafuufa sandakwajeanda neajeeda aba hoowa.
Ak gwasin gadiyeeda sarmeeda aba madeeda maheemajeanda siroondooscheesa was heeda wagiida bwak ea ghwadeas Sulemani gheeda NG'UTAMIIDA aba Yerusalemu; ak gwasin gadiyeeda nyaawa nea gwalageanyi.
Suh fuga sin gadiyeeda gil sea orjooga nyaawa. Aba orjooga eemeeda Gohati: Hemani was siida sarmani was orjeeda Yoeli, ea orjeeda Samweli,
ea orjeeda Elikana, ea orjeeda Yerohamu, ea orjeeda Elihu, sea orjeeda Dohu,
ea orjeeda Sufu, ea orjeeda Elikana, ea orjeeda Mahati, ea orjeeda Amasayi,
ea orjeeda Elikana, ea orjeeda Yoeli, ea orjeeda Asariya, ea orjeeda Sefaniya,
ea orjeeda Dahati, ea orjeeda Asiri, ea orjeeda Ebiasafu, ea orjeeda Gora,
ea orjeeda Ishari, ea orjeeda Gohati, orjeeda Lawi, orjeeda Israeli;
Ea orjeeda ghaamwat siguura Asafu miinaada aba meatkweadaanyi bea geatinda dugwa nea Asafu ea orjeeda Berekiya gil, was orjeeda Shimeya,
orjeeda Mikaeli, orjeeda Baaseya, orjeeda Malkiya,
orjeeda Etini, orjeeda Sera, orjeeda Adaya,
orjeeda Etani, orjeeda Sima, orjeeda Shimeyi,
orjeeda Yahati, orjeeda Gershomu, orjeeda Lawi.
Nea meatkweeda geatinda ghaadaam buweadeega nyaawa was orjooga Merari: Etani orjeeda Gishi, orjeeda Abdi; orjeeda Maluki,
orjeeda Hashabiya, orjeeda Amasiya, orjeeda Hilkiya,
orjeeda Amsi, orjeeda Bani, orjeeda Shemeri,
orjeeda Mahli, orjeeda Mushi, orjeeda Merari, orjeeda Lawi;
sea buweadeega nyaawa duupchi was fuga Lawi gealoat gwasin gadiyoojiga sean heeda ghaydit bea gheeda ASEETA.
Jeacheenga Haruni

Iimuchu ghoadayda Haruni sea orjoagaaschi haleanjeeda sisapa geadi sigwariida bea ghadooweeda aba heeda wagiida mida geediga ng'andidi aba gadiyoojiga sean bea heeda ghaydit muuchi, ak gwasin giiduupcheeda aba badayda Israeli, gawuurji ng'asheega sean rugu Musaheeda was siida gadiyeeda ASEETA.
Suh orjooga Haruni: Eliyasari gwaji Finehasi, Finehasi gwaji Abishuwa,
Abishuwa gwaji Buki, Buki gwaji Usi, Usi gwaji Serahiya,
Serahiya gwaji Merayoti, Merayoti gwaji Amariya, Amariya gwaji Ahitubu,
Ahitubu gwaji Sadoki, Sadoki gwaji Ahimasi.
Darooraka abiita fuga Lawi
Suh darooraka nyaawa abiita aba giduurji giibinda nyaawa ea moonghajeega nyaawa: Orjooga Haruni bea dooshta Gohati, aba gideaba saawa gealoat aba mwadi,
geataw saawa Hebroni mida ng'eanyiida Yuda sea ng'eanyiida neaweesa mida nyeega,
nea madameega mujiini ea gharang'weakaaschi geataw Galebu was orjeeda Yefune.
Nea orjooga Haruni geataw mujiinajeega simng'awiisa: Hebroni, ea Libna sea ng'eanyiidaanyi mida nyeega, ea Yatiri, ea Eshtemowa sea ng'eanyiidaanyi mida nyeega,
Hileni sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Debiri sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega,
Ashani sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Bet-shemeshi sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega;

nea aba eemeeda Benjamini, ea Geba gil ea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Alemeti sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Anatoti sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega. Mujiinajeega sean ikaanyaawa aba giteena fuga gheanyaawa mujiinajeega ea damasamwagu.
Nea fuga mwaatkwa bea eemeeda Gohati geataw aba loota aba jeeda Manase, mujiinaji damanamughuush.
Orjooga Gershoni ea fuga gheanyaawa geataw saawa mujiinaji damasamwagu aba jeeda eemoojiga Isakari, ea aba jeeda eemeeda Asheri, ea Naftali ea Manase mida Bashani.
Nea orjooga Merari geeloosa mujiinaji damaniyeenya aba giteena fuga gheanyaawa aba jeeda fuga eemeeda Rubeni, ea Gadi ea Sabuloni.
Ak ghoadaw fuga Israeli eemeeda Lawi mujiinajeega ea darooraka nyaawa bea nyeega.
Geataw saawa aba jeeda eemeeda Yuda, ea Simeoni, ea Benjamini mujiinajeesu sirugu gheawungean.
Ea fuga mwaatkwa bea orjooga Gohati gwandeawa mujiinajeega nyaawa ascheayi sea eemeeda Efraimu.
Ak geataw mujiinajeega simng'awwiisa: Shekemu sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega mida ng'eanyiida heayeeniga Efraimu, ea Geseri sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega,
ea Yokmeyamu sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Bet-horoni sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega,
ea Aiyaloni sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega ea Gat-rimoni sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega,
nea aba jeeda fuga mwaatkwa bea Manase, Aneri sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Bileamu sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, aba fuga was boosteanga bea gheeh Gohati.
Ak geataw fuga gheeh Gershoni mujiinajeesu aba jeeda fuga mwaatkwa bea Manase: Golani mida Bashani sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega ea Ashtaroti sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega;
nea aba jeeda eemeeda Israeli: geataw Gedeshi sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Daberati sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega,
Ramoti sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Anemu sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega;
aba jeeda fuga eemeeda Asheri: Mashali gil sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, Abdoni sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega,
ea Helkati sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Rehobu sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega,
nea aba jeeda eemeeda Naftali: Gedeshi mida Galilaya sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Hamoni sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Giriataimu sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega.
Nea fuga mwaatkwa bea Merari gealoat aba jeeda eemeeda Sabuloni: Rimona sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, Dabori sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega,
nea giigheawda Yordani mida ng'eanyiida Yeriko, mida gayeewda Yordani, aba jeeda eemeeda Rubeni: Beseri gil mida mooheeda sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Yahasa sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega,
Gedemoti sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Mefati sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega;
nea aba jeeda eemeeda Gadi: Ramoti gil mida Gileyadi sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Mahanaimu sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega,
Heshboni sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega, ea Yaseri sea ng'eanyiidaanyi bea nyeega.
